patterns.note: A full-width, full-height hero section with a massive, central brand element that dominates the initial view, transitioning into a compact sticky header.
The site uses a single, highly legible sans-serif font family across various weights and sizes, with an emphasis on oversized, bold display text for the brand and project titles.
A stark, monochrome palette of black, white, and subtle light greys dominates the site, with color introduced sparingly within project imagery.
The initial oversized 'vennn' logo at the top of the page shrinks and transitions into a compact, sticky header as the user scrolls down.
A large, abstract 3D wireframe graphic of 'vennn' is fixed in the background and gradually revealed as the foreground content scrolls past it, creating a depth effect.
Project cards and content sections animate into view with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport.
Project showcases are presented in a clean, responsive grid layout with consistent aspect ratios for image thumbnails.

technique_notes: The main brand logo at the top of the page uses a scroll-triggered animation (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger) to scale down and reposition itself into a sticky header element upon scrolling, creating a dynamic brand presence.
Content sections and individual project cards are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic loading effect for new content.

A large, abstract 3D graphic is positioned as a fixed background element, allowing foreground content to scroll over it and progressively reveal the graphic, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display logo/headings (~5x body text) with smaller, highly legible body and caption text, creating a strong typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and footer, balanced in the project grid, with generous whitespace contributing to a minimalist aesthetic.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a massive, fixed brand logo that scales and transforms into a sticky header, combined with a minimalist, monochrome aesthetic and a subtle 3D wireframe graphic that reveals itself as a background element, creates a strong brand presence and a unique, sophisticated scrolling experience.
